name: How long does it take to replace laundry room flooring?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace laundry room flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for replacing laundry room flooring depends on the type of material, room size, and whether old flooring needs to be removed. A simple luxury vinyl plank installation might take 1-2 days, including subfloor preparation. Tile installation, which involves setting mortar, grouting, and cure times, typically takes 3-5 days. Complex projects or those requiring extensive subfloor repair can take longer. Your contractor can provide a more precise timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies: 1-2 days for luxury vinyl plank, and 3-5 days for tile, depending on room size and prep work.
